title: Fixed Centre Pivot Sloping Rooflight
description: One original complete fixed-open centre-pivot sloping rooflight module. One deep whole perimeter curb with a continuous raised inner rebate surrounds a single complete framed opaque illustrative pane. The sash turns about its middle horizontal axis in the displayed pose, crossing above and below the sloping curb plane; finite side trunnions and bearing housings connect it to both side rails. Four finite exterior mounting ears and one lower-edge grip complete the assembly. This is not the old rear-edge-hinged garden cold-frame container or two parallel-depth sliding sash window; no old geometry is imported or rescaled. Three constant opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up, true whole horizontal envelope centred and lowest displayed point Z0. One isolated module, zero scenes; host roof and flashing environment are omitted, and the lowest displayed point is not claimed as a mounting sole. No transparent glazing, movement sweep, watertightness, weather, ventilation, egress, host fit, installation, support or safety claim.
